scope: Strengthen existing AC1024 DIMASSOC whole-write allocation-failure evidence so the writer receives the caller record itself and retries are checked against clean bytes.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored in-memory DRW_DimensionAssociation generated during each test run

implementation.method: Pass the exporter’s mutable association directly to writeDimensionAssociation; compare the complete modeled caller record, extension-dictionary flag, and reactor count after clean write, every injected allocation failure, and same-codec retry. Preserve the destination sentinel on failure, compare retry bytes with clean bytes, and retain exact typed fileImport readback with handle remapping.

limitations: Generated AC1024 transport/transaction evidence only; source-producer breadth and native associative behavior remain unqualified.
The writer is exercised through an existing single-record generated callback; whole-document DIMASSOC graph closure remains separately gated.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
